'''Rithgar''' was a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and the master of the [[Kothlis shadowport]].
==Biography==
Rithgar spent 30 years in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as a pirate. He enjoyed collecting loot. During his adventures he acquired several injuries, including when a [[vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] almost cut his neck.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

By the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he had settled on the feature-rich [[Kothlis' second moon]], and used its craters to form a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. He opposed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but did not show special support for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="guide" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], his men salvaged a [[Tech 4 PDV]] that had crashed on the [[Third moon of Kothlis]] and stored it in one of the shadowport's storage bays. Not wanting to lead the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] there, he hired some [[scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]] to take it away, and reprogram it with false information. When the agents arrived, he pretended to not know them, cautious of [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. However when a band of [[pirate/Legends|pirates]] attempted to attack them and claim the PDV for their own benefit, Rithgar, who did not tolerate violence in his shadowport, taught them a lesson with his [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Operation: Recovery|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>

Around the same time, Rithgar had invited a few [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to his chambers within the Kothlis shadowport, including [[To'iir]], [[Liadden]], and [[Tru'eb Cholakk]]. The friendly meeting was broken up early when, unexpectedly, a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]] approached the shadowport.

==Personality and traits==
Rithgar was tall, broad, with a well-groomed beard. He kept his good shape and beard even when he aged. He had eight scars, including a conspicuous wound on the right side of his neck.<ref name="guide" />

Rithgar practiced piracy for the excitement, and valued looted objects more than [[Currency/Legends|money]]. He hoarded his loot without selling it, and still had it with him when he retired in the shadowport. His disinterest in riches was expressed by offering the shadowport's facilities without charge to his fellow pirates and [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who visited, and loved associating with them, hearing news. However he lacked manners and could be offensive to strangers.<ref name="guide" />

He enjoyed old liquor and shared it with special guests.<ref name="guide" />

He disliked [[droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="guide" />

==Equipment==
He lived in private quarters within the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], where the loot from his past pirating days was held. He kept a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] on him at all [[Time/Legends|times]], and owned an old [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="guide" />
